scope: validation-only parameterization of post-primary-test fusion baselines

chronology.reporting_requirement: Describe these fusion baselines as post-hoc comparison protocols parameterized only on validation data; do not claim they were pre-registered before the primary formal TEST.

same_grouping_as_etce.stage1: case_id × model × prefix × surrogate × predicted_class × feature_signature

common_protocol.same_fused_rule_re_evaluation_policy: After a baseline selects one interpretable rule hypothesis for a group, recompute n_r, Fid(r), coverage, and R(r) on the same frozen held-out cache before propagating it to the next hierarchy level.
common_protocol.candidate_hypothesis_policy: Non-D-S baselines select from hypotheses already present among the group inputs. They do not synthesize new intersection hypotheses. The ability of D-S to create a supported intersection is therefore part of the method difference, not silently granted to baselines.
common_protocol.global_tie_break: higher aggregation score -> higher input R -> more specific rule -> lexical canonical rule

best_single_surrogate.selection_rule: highest validation mean R; tie -> mean Fidelity -> eligible-CF count -> frozen surrogate order

best_single_model.selection_rule: highest validation mean R; tie -> mean Fidelity -> eligible-CF count -> frozen model order

validation_fixed_weights.surrogate_weight_basis: normalized validation mean support-aware reliability R at lambda=5
validation_fixed_weights.model_weight_basis: normalized validation mean support-aware reliability R at lambda=5

best_single_evidence.definition: Select the input rule with maximum R_i. Tie -> more specific -> lexical canonical rule.

validation_best_source.definition: At Stage2 prefer the validation-selected best surrogate when present; at Stage3 prefer the validation-selected best black-box model when present. If absent, fall back to maximum-R input with the global tie-break.

uniform_vote.definition: Group inputs by exact canonical rule hypothesis; score(H)=number of input evidence units with hypothesis H. Select maximum score.

validation_weighted_vote.definition: Group inputs by exact canonical hypothesis. Stage1 score(H)=sum R_i. Stage2 score(H)=sum[R_i * w_surrogate(i)]. Stage3 score(H)=sum[R_i * w_model(i)].

fuzzy_probabilistic_or.definition: For each exact candidate hypothesis H, each supporting input has membership mu_i=clip(R_i,0,1). Aggregate repeated support with the parameter-free probabilistic fuzzy OR: mu(H)=1-product_i(1-mu_i). Select maximum mu(H).

bayesian_categorical_noise.definition: Candidate states are the unique input hypotheses. Use a uniform prior. For M unique hypotheses and evidence i with reliability R_i: P(e_i|H)=R_i if H equals the input hypothesis; otherwise (1-R_i)/(M-1). Compute posterior scores in log space with epsilon guard and select maximum posterior.

probability_averaging.definition: Only valid if comparable calibrated surrogate class probabilities exist in the canonical evidence bank. Fid_r, R_r, coverage, and factual black-box probability must NOT be relabeled as surrogate class probabilities.

ds_etce.definition: Support-aware simple-support BPA with Dempster combination, conflict K, ignorance Theta, deterministic representative-rule selection, and held-out re-evaluation.

evaluation.primary_scope: genuinely fusable compatible groups at each hierarchy stage
evaluation.comparison_requirement: Use the same validation/test compatibility groups and the same held-out cache for every operator; report counts and matched comparisons.

freeze_rule: After this config is written, baseline formulas, validation-selected source weights, source choices, tie-breaks, and epsilon must not be changed in response to formal TEST baseline results.
